reading: The sketch is a landing-page hero: a top nav bar ('Stratum' logo + 'Product · Docs · Pricing · Sign in'), a large blurred pink circle bleeding off the right edge, a giant gradient headline 'Infrastructure with depth.', and a tilted 3D frosted-glass card showing a '99.98%' uptime stat with caption 'uptime across 41 regions'. On the left is a blurred teal circle holding a paragraph of body copy and two pill buttons, 'Start free' and 'Talk to sales'. The whole page is meant to be near-black indigo with Helvetica type and light grey text.
